title: M6 exact pinned dual enumerator in shared Option-pin representation
pending_dependency: ../experiment accepted weighted_macwilliams closure; do not launch before verified promotion

spec.name: M6.Character.weight_as_sum
spec.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (v : M6.Character.Vector m), M6.Pinned.weight v = ∑ i, (v i).val
queries: binary weight finite sum polynomial product
spec.guidance: Express filtered card as sum of indicators; each ZMod2 value is0 or1. fin_cases the coordinate value, with norm_num [ZMod.val_zero,ZMod.val_one]. Return tactic lines only, no leading by.

spec.name: M6.Character.pinned_product
spec.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (P : M6.Pinned.Pins m) (v : M6.Character.Vector m), (∏ i, M6.Character.boundaryFactor P i (v i)) = M6.Character.pinnedMonomial P v
queries: binary weight finite sum polynomial product
spec.guidance: If agrees then every local factor is X^val; combine using pow_sum and weight_as_sum. If not, extract a pinned coordinate which disagrees and use product zero. Inspect Option pin; no extra pin assumptions. Return tactic lines only, no leading by.

spec.name: M6.Character.free_character_factor
spec.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (i : Fin m) (s : ZMod 2), M6.Character.pinnedCharacterFactor (M6.Pinned.free m) i s = 1 + Polynomial.C (M6.Character.sign s) * Polynomial.X
queries: binary weight finite sum polynomial product
spec.guidance: Expand the sum over ZMod2 explicitly, evaluate local factors of0 and1, simplify signs at0 and multiplication by1. Return tactic lines only, no leading by.

spec.name: M6.Character.pinned_macwilliams
spec.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (D : Submodule (ZMod 2) (M6.Character.Vector m)) (P : M6.Pinned.Pins m), Polynomial.C ((M6.Character.subspaceWords D).card : ℤ) * M6.Pinned.enumerator (M6.Character.dualWords D) P = M6.Character.pinnedTransform D P
queries: binary weight finite sum polynomial product
spec.guidance: Use imported accepted weighted_macwilliams with w=boundaryFactor P. Its weightedDual is exactly Pinned.enumerator by pinned_product; transform unfolds pinnedCharacterFactor. Preserve actual Option pins and integer polynomials. Return tactic lines only, no leading by.
